title: Anonymous valid session creation
frontend_evidence: frontend:tests/e2e/assistant.spec.ts "and sends no credentials"

title: Missing session grant
note: Missing grant gets 401/403, the body does not reveal the session id and no turn is answered; DELETE without a grant gets 401

title: Tampered session grant
note: Grant is an opaque random token looked up by SHA-256 hash; a grant with one byte changed is rejected and never reaches the answerer

title: Expired grant
frontend_evidence: frontend:components/assistant/AssistantWidget.test.tsx "a 401 mid-chat starts a new session and retries once with a new turn id, in the same bubble"
note: Backend returns 401 session_expired; the widget starts a new anonymous session and retries once with a new turn id

title: Cross-session session_id
note: Grant A used with session B's id gets 403 scope_denied

title: Turn GET/SSE with other session token
note: R0 has no turn GET route and the SSE events route returns 404 for any caller; no test sends another session's token specifically

title: DELETE other session
note: A foreign grant gets a generic 404 and the session survives

title: Repeat DELETE own session
note: Repeat delete returns 204 and a deleted session cannot start turns

title: Same idempotency key same payload
note: Identical body is returned and the model path is called once

title: Same key different payload
note: Returns 422 publicai.idempotency_mismatch
